correctness.rationale: On the labelled 2×n torus with n even, north and south refer to the same opposite-row site but must count twice as two directed neighbors. A full checkerboard Q2R step can be fixed only if the first half-phase flips no site, since the second phase never touches the first color; then no site in the second phase may flip either. This is the exact no-two-one-neighbors criterion. The 16 pair-column transfer T(u) checks both central-row predicates with a_r+c_r+2b_{1−r}≠2, has 36 allowed transitions, and accumulates 2 vertical plus 2 horizontal bond-disagreement terms per step, hence labelled cyclic words ↔ trace(T(u)^n) with E correctly counted over 4n bonds. Independently reconstructed the symbolic charpoly factorization into degrees (2,4,4,6) and verified it is IDENTICAL as a polynomial in y and u, not a finite-n fit. The trace/log-det identity gives the all-even-n energy polynomial. At u=1 the factor roots give the stated Lucas and cosine formula with leading φ^{2n}; per-spin entropy logφ. Checkerboard xor gauge preserves the no-two predicate and flips every bond disagreement, giving Z_n(u)=u^{4n}Z_n(1/u), mean E=2n. A separately coded original-site brute-force enumeration of all 2^{2n} states for n=4,6,8 found 36,400,2116 frozen configurations and symmetric full histograms; those finite checks corroborate, while the finite exact 16×16 determinant and universal trace bijection prove every n.
residual_risks: Odd n invalidates global checkerboard parity; n≥4 even only. Two vertical directions must be counted separately; no claim for undirected simple prism.
